cards.label: Whitechapel Road
cards.text: The shop's open. Hakim's behind the till, serving, making change, saying thank you to every single customer.
The door to the yard is shut. There's a new padlock on the gate beyond it, and it isn't his.

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: "Came this morning. Three of them, very polite. One had a clipboard." He straightens the lighters on the counter. "Nobody touched me this time. Nobody needed to."
The homework's back on the counter, finished this time, the biro clipped to the cover. Somebody's written their name on it very neatly.

cards.speaker: Hakim
cards.text: "It was only ever a third of the rent. We'll manage." He says it the way people say things they've already said to someone else at home.
Everything that was meant to hold did. The yard went anyway.
